subject: MSA: Confidentiality & Publicity - coordination and final items
messages:
From: Tom Hargreaves <tom.h@cloudsentry.com>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Cc: legal@cloudsentry.com
Date: 2026-10-12T09:32:00-07:00
Subject: MSA - Confidentiality & Publicity (initial redlines)

Hi Grace,

Thanks for sending over the MSA and order form. Our legal team took a pass and attached CloudSentry_MSA_Redline_v2.pdf with some suggested edits focused on confidentiality carveouts and publicity rights. Main items they flagged:
- Publicity: Broad "reference" language in Section 7 looks open-ended; asking to limit logo use and require pre-approval for quotes.
- Confidentiality exceptions: want a carveout for aggregated/anonymous telemetry used for product improvements.
- Embargo timing: proposing a 30-day notice before public announcements.

Can you loop in Redwood legal and let us know which of these are deal breakers vs. negotiable? We're keen to close quickly and can be flexible on timing for the announcement.

Attachments: CloudSentry_MSA_Redline_v2.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)

Cheers,
Tom
Head of Partnerships, CloudSentry

From: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
To: Tom Hargreaves <tom.h@cloudsentry.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-12T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MSA - Confidentiality & Publicity (initial redlines)

Tom —

Appreciate the quick pass and the annotated redline. Looping in Ben (AE) and Marissa (legal) to assess. High-level from our side: we broadly support a telemetry exception for aggregated data (that's standard), but we try to keep reference rights fairly permissive for case studies because it materially impacts GTM. That said, we can agree to a narrower publicity clause with clear pre-approval windows and logo usage controls.

Goals for this thread:
- Get legal's recommended language for confidentiality exception and publicity permission (one consolidated redline).
- Confirm embargo/announcement timing that works for both teams.
- Finalize where logo assets will be stored and who owns approval.

Marissa — could you take the attached and propose specific language (redline + a 2-3 bullet rationale) by EOD tomorrow? Ben, once we have the language, can you confirm whether marketing needs broader rights or if pre-approved references suffice for the close?

Thanks —
Grace
Sr. Account Lead, Redwood Inference

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-12T11:42:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: MSA - Confidentiality & Publicity (initial redlines)

Marissa / Grace — forwarding Tom's redline. Quick commercial notes from my side to consider when drafting:
- We need the ability to publish a brief case study (1-2 paragraphs + anonymized numbers) within 60 days of go-live; that helps other prospects.
- Logo on partner/customer page (small, non-prominent) is important for our marketplace motion.
- If they insist on pre-approval for every mention, that will slow references; ask for a streamlined approval window (48-72 hours) rather than full sign-off each time.

If legal can meet us halfway (pre-approval + short window + limited embargo), should be ok.

-Ben

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-13T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MSA - Confidentiality & Publicity (initial redlines)

Grace / Ben —

Thanks — I reviewed CloudSentry_MSA_Redline_v2.pdf and sketched a consolidated set of edits. Attaching Redlines_Marissa_20261013.pdf with tracked changes and a short summary below. Key proposed positions (legal rationale included):

1) Confidentiality (Section 5):
- Keep standard definition of Confidential Information.
- Add explicit exception: "Information that is de-identified and aggregated such that it cannot reasonably be re-identified" may be used by either party for product improvement and benchmarking.
- Add a limited retention note: Redwood will retain logs relevant to provision of service for up to 13 months unless a longer retention is requested in writing.

Rationale: protects CloudSentry's sensitive data while preserving Redwood's ability to improve models and support customers.

2) Publicity / Reference Rights (Section 7):
- Proposed replacement language: "Subject to prior written consent, which shall not be unreasonably withheld or delayed, Redwood may (a) list CloudSentry as a customer in marketing materials and on its website, (b) use CloudSentry's name and logo in a non-prominent manner on Redwood's partners and customers page, and (c) publish a case study with CloudSentry's pre-approved quotes. The approval process shall not exceed 72 hours from receipt of a written request for approval. Either party may withhold consent for use of Confidential Information or specific customer metrics."
- Embargo/Announcement timing: propose 45 days' notice for joint public announcements unless both parties agree otherwise in writing.

Rationale: balances marketing needs with customer control; 72-hour window enforces a practical cadence. "Unreasonably withheld" language gives us leverage if they drag their feet.

3) Logo assets / approvals:
- Ask that CloudSentry provide a single high-res logo package and a designated approver email. Logo use shall be limited to the uses in the publicity section; any other use requires pre-approval.

Next steps I recommend:
- Share the attached redline with CloudSentry as Redwood's counter-proposal.
- Ask CloudSentry to confirm approver email and provide logo assets.
- If they accept the 72-hour approval window and 45-day embargo, we can proceed to finalize the MSA and send for signature.

Attachments: Redlines_Marissa_20261013.pdf (PDF, 340KB)

-M
Marissa Cole
Legal Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: Tom Hargreaves <tom.h@cloudsentry.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Cc: Rita Gomez <legal@cloudsentry.com>
Date: 2026-10-14T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MSA - Confidentiality & Publicity (initial redlines)

Marissa / Grace —

Thanks for the thoughtful counter-proposal and the 72-hour SLA suggestion — that helps. A few clarifications and small asks from our side:

- Case studies: we can agree to a 72-hour approval window but ask that the default be anonymized metrics unless CloudSentry explicitly signs off on named metrics.
- Logo use: happy to provide a single approved logo package. We want the right to request removal from any endorsing page if the placement misrepresents partnership strength (e.g., not implying a strategic partnership).
- Embargo: 30 days is our preferred maximum, but we can accept 45 days if Redwood can commit to not initiating announcements earlier than the agreed notice.

Proposed tweak to your suggested publicity paragraph (inline):
"Subject to prior written consent, which shall not be unreasonably withheld or delayed, Redwood may (a) list CloudSentry as a customer in marketing materials and on its website, (b) use CloudSentry's name and logo in a non-prominent manner on Redwood's partners and customers page, and (c) publish a case study with CloudSentry's pre-approved quotes. The approval process shall not exceed 72 hours from receipt of a written request for approval. Either party may withhold consent for use of Confidential Information or specific customer metrics; absent explicit consent, published metrics shall be anonymized."

We will upload the logo and provide a single approver (legal@cloudsentry.com). Attaching logo: cloudsentry_logo.zip and press asset specs: press_asset_specs.pdf

If that wording looks good, we'll sign off and return a final redline.

Best,
Tom

From: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
To: Tom Hargreaves <tom.h@cloudsentry.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-16T16:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MSA - Confidentiality & Publicity (initial redlines)

Tom —

Appreciate the quick response and the logo package. We're happy to accept the adjusted publicity paragraph with two minor clarifications:
1) Add explicit "anonymized by default" language for case studies unless CloudSentry provides written approval to include named metrics.
2) Confirmation that the 72-hour review window applies to logo and case study approvals and that the clock starts on receipt of final materials.

If CloudSentry confirms those two points in writing, Redwood legal will incorporate the agreed text into the final MSA redline and circulate a DocuSign link. Next steps from here:
- CloudSentry to confirm approver email (you noted legal@cloudsentry.com) and confirm 45-day embargo acceptance (or 30 if you prefer).
- CloudSentry to return the final redline (or confirm our consolidated redline) so we can generate a signature packet.
- Provide logo assets to the shared Drive folder (link below) and grant Redwood view/comment access to speed approvals.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdExampleCloudSentryMSA
DocuSign (will be generated after final redline): https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abc123-cloudsentry-msa

I'll hold off on marketing outreach until we have the signed MSA and a confirmed announcement date. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround — moving to finalize.

-Grace
Sr. Account Lead, Redwood Inference
